name: Soku Hame Nyuuin Seikatsu no Susume -Zetsurin Kyokon ♂ ni Muragaru Onna-tachi
original_name: 即ハメ入院生活のススメ-絶倫巨根♂に群がるオンナたち
source:
“My arms might be broken, but my dick works just fine!”

After saving a stranger from an accident, you end up hospitalized with both arms in casts. You’ve lost the use of your hands—but not your manhood.

In your hospital room, you’re visited by three very different women:

A guilt-ridden office worker,

a nurse who promises to take very good care of you,

and a doctor with a thing for younger men.

You can’t fall asleep unless you get off, and the three are happy to oblige.

Your quiet recovery quickly spirals into a full-blown harem disaster. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4186090/]Steam[/url]]
